title: Enrollment
description: The one-time exchange in which a device presents an enrollment token and a confirmed email and receives its device key.

contract_version.description: Version of the wire contract the request conforms to.

enrollment_token.description: The enrollment token the engineer's Neo.Tax admin issued; it can only enroll devices.

email.description: The email the engineer confirms at login, stored with the device key.

email_confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed the email: engineer when the engineer typed or chose it at login.

device.description: The machine and harness being enrolled.

hostname.description: The machine's hostname as the operating system reports it at enrollment, recorded as a readable name for the device id so engineers can tell their devices apart. It often contains the engineer's name. It is not updated if the hostname changes later; enrolling again sends the current hostname under a new device id.

os.description: Operating system, for example darwin or linux.

arch.description: CPU architecture, for example arm64 or amd64.

harness.description: Which coding harness the device is enrolled for, for example claude-code.

harness_version.description: Version of the harness; null when unknown.
